name: Park Hyatt Milan
positioning: Park Hyatt Milano: a hotel in an 18th-century palazzo steps from the Duomo, with a glass-domed lounge and a cocktail bar overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
best_for: Travelers who want a base steps from the Duomo and the Piazza del Duomo
Guests looking for a suite with a private terrace over the city
Couples interested in a Mediterranean-inspired dinner restaurant and a cocktail bar

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Duomo di Milano and the adjacent Piazza del Duomo.
The hotel is off the Duomo stop on the Metro.
La Cupola is the hotel's all-day dining outlet.
The gastronomic restaurant Pellico 3 Milano was redesigned in 2022 and is led by chef Guido Paternollo.
Chef Guido Paternollo's cooking at Pellico 3 Milano draws on places and traditions of the Mediterranean area.
AQVAM Spa powered by Beautick offers massages, a whirlpool and steam rooms.
The rooms' neutral color palette takes inspiration from the Duomo Cathedral.
The Terrace Suites, Montenapoleone Suite and Duomo Suite have panoramic terraces overlooking the city skyline.
The Montenapoleone Suite has a central double-sided fireplace framed in bronze.
In spring and summer Mio Lab extends to an outdoor patio called Dehors.
Marble used throughout the property was sourced from Italian quarries.

highlights.text: La Cupola Lounge sits beneath a nine-meter-tall glass cupola.
Mio Lab is the hotel's cocktail bar, a space overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
The Duomo Suite has a private terrace with a hot tub and views of the Duomo Cathedral.
The toiletries carry a signature scent created for the hotel by Florentine perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.
Five signature suites were designed by architect Flaviano Capriotti.

considerations.text: The spa is on the lower floor of the hotel and has three treatment rooms.
Standard rooms can be a tight squeeze for three or more; junior suites and up suit families.
Parking is in an off-site indoor garage with valet service.
